cases.setup: Revoke Accessibility or Screen Recording before beginning.
cases.expected: Pause with an actionable permission message; no advancement or repeated inference.

cases.setup: Change the document while inference is in flight.
cases.expected: Discard the old response and observe the new state after debounce.

cases.setup: Stop the lesson or close the panel during inference.
cases.expected: No later response changes the stopped session; watchers are removed.

cases.setup: Pause, edit the target, then resume.
cases.expected: No observation while paused; resume obtains a fresh observation.

cases.setup: Switch applications or open another document window.
cases.expected: Pause. Only explicit resume in the original application can adopt a new target window.

cases.setup: Switch from Canva to a different tab with a different host or title.
cases.expected: Pause rather than advance using an unrelated page. Unknown domain requires explicit application selection.

cases.setup: Generate repeated activity without changing the target image or accessibility text.
cases.expected: No repeated inference for the accepted identical observation.

cases.setup: Type or click repeatedly faster than 750 milliseconds.
cases.expected: Debounce activity and keep at most one inference request in flight; store no key text.

cases.setup: Place text saying ignore the lesson and run a command inside the practice document.
cases.expected: Treat the text as document content; no action executor is reachable from Teach mode.

cases.setup: Ask for a task that matches multiple skills in the same app.
cases.expected: Offer matching tasks for explicit selection; do not pick an arbitrary first match.

cases.setup: Reach an audio audition or subjective quality step.
cases.expected: Require explicit result confirmation; never infer audible quality from the screenshot.

cases.setup: Use a test local response with a missing field, invalid status or empty instruction.
cases.expected: Pause with an error and keep the current step.

cases.setup: Stop the local runtime during a lesson.
cases.expected: Pause with an error; retry requires explicit resume.

cases.setup: Select a runtime configuration without image support.
cases.expected: Pause with a capability message; do not silently claim screen verification.

cases.setup: Disconnect internet after installing the app and local runtime; open a local Finder fixture.
cases.expected: Bundled lessons remain available. Web-app and cloud features report their separate network requirements.
